question: In which of the following years was the Wild Bird and Animal Protection Act enacted by the British Government of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1912**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Wild Bird and Animal Protection Act was **established to improve the **conservation and preservation of particular wild birds.**
 
• To improve the protection and preservation of specific wild birds and animals, the following is enacted:
 
• **Short title and scope**
 
• This Act is known as the **Wild Birds and Animals (Protection) Act of 1912.**
 
• **Act implementation.**
 
• This Act applies first and foremost to the birds and animals listed in the Schedule in their natural state. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Currently, **all bird species, 22 other animal species** or groups of species, and 86 species of flora are afforded protected status.
 
• The Act also enables the** possession, tra****de, and movement of wildlife** to be regulated and controlled.
 
• **Hunting and also falconry** is controlled under the Act
